facts.fact: Equinix, the US data-centre company, is stated to have committed up to US$390 million to African expansion, including a US$22 million Lagos data centre (LG3) scheduled for early 2026; the document gives no signing date, so the year is taken from the scheduled opening and the article's 2026 publication.

note: IFC US$50m equity and US$20.4m loan to WIOCC (signed 2025-12-10) is multi-country with no amount named for Nigeria, so no fact; Equinix US$22m Lagos is the only NGA amount.
